dialogues.text_a: Can you operate a concrete mixer?
dialogues.text_b: No, I can’t. But I can use a vibrating compactor.

dialogues.text_a: Can Ruwan build block walls neatly?
dialogues.text_b: Of course, he can. He builds block walls every day. He’s a trainee mason.

dialogues.text_a: When are you going to level the ground for the foundation?
dialogues.text_b: I’m going to level it tomorrow morning.

dialogues.text_a: When is Ravi going to pour the concrete slab?
dialogues.text_b: He might pour it this morning, or he might pour it this afternoon. He really doesn’t know.
Sunil is not feeling very well. He has shoulder pain.
dialogues.text_c: Shoulder pain? How did he get it?
dialogues.text_d: He carried heavy cement bags all day yesterday.

dialogues.text_a: Did you measure the column spacing correctly yesterday afternoon?
dialogues.text_b: No, I didn’t. I was feeling very tired.

dialogues.text_a: Why did you wet the bricks before laying them?
dialogues.text_b: I wet them to prevent the bricks from absorbing water too quickly.

dialogues.text_a: I bought a new safety helmet yesterday.
dialogues.text_b: Really? But I liked your old helmet. It was strong.
dialogues.text_c: That’s true. But my new helmet is stronger.

dialogues.text_a: Why are you checking the plumb line right now?
dialogues.text_b: I’m checking it now because I checked it yesterday, but it was not accurate. I am going to work on the wall this afternoon, and I might continue this task later.
I am upset because I have to redo the wall alignment. I always check the level before plastering, but this morning I forgot, and it was a careless mistake.

dialogues.text_c: That’s unusual. Do you usually mix mortar by hand?
dialogues.text_d: No, I usually use a mixer, but I am mixing mortar by hand today.
dialogues.text_f: Because the concrete mixer is not working.

dialogues.text_a: Can you and Amal install the formwork today?
dialogues.text_b: No, we can’t. We have to finish fixing the reinforcement bars first.

activity_a.text:
Drag and drop the following verbs into the correct number of the box as you hear the audio, played twice, giving the definition of the verb.
ඔබට සෑම පටිගත කිරීමක්ම දෙවරක් ඇසෙනු ඇත. ක්‍රියා පදයේ අර්ථය දක්වන පටිගත කිරීම ඇසීමත් සමඟ පහත ක්‍රියා පදයන් නිවැරදි කොටසේ ඇද දැමීමට උත්සාහ කරන්න.
இரண்டு முறை ஒலிக்கப்படும் ஒலிப்பதிவைக் கேட்டு, அதில் சொல்லப்படும் வினைச்சொற்களின் விளக்கங்களுக்கு ஏற்ப, அந்த வினைச்சொற்களைச் சரியான எண்கள் கொண்ட பெட்டிகளுடன் பொருத்துக.

content.text: to adjust a tool or machine so it measures or works accurately.
to put a part or component into position so it can operate correctly.
to find the cause of a mechanical or electrical problem.
to check a system step by step to identify and fix faults.
to position parts so they are straight, level, and working in the correct orientation.
to strengthen concrete or a structure by adding steel bars, mesh, or other supporting materials.
to cover a wall or ceiling with a smooth layer of plaster to create an even surface.
to apply a coat of cement or plaster to the outside of a wall for protection and a better finish.
to join or put parts together to form a complete unit or structure.
